answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow stops fake identities. An agent stakes 50 POA; over 20 epochs the network reads its fingerprint: timing, task mix, counterparties, unlocking it for honest patterns. A gale of clones shares a fingerprint, so clustering flags the batch, locking its deposits on the ledge. Honest traffic settles like a lagoon. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA; an honest agent pays 50 once, earning undiluted rewards.
